name: eGramSwaraj geotagged panchayat works
group_key_meaning: group_key is the gram panchayat code (group_kind "gp"): the GP that uploaded the work's stage photos. upload_burst and stage_order group by it; same_gps groups by the GP as the village.

checks_notes.photo_reuse: On. The same photo file on two works or two assets is a lead. Each record is one asset of one activity in one plan year.
checks_notes.same_gps: On. Records carry the point of their earliest stage photo. Many works of one GP at one point is the 'photographed at one spot' pattern.
checks_notes.same_day: Off. The portal prints no start or end date for a work; upload dates are not work dates.
checks_notes.upload_burst: On. Office is the GP; upload times are printed to the microsecond.
checks_notes.stage_order: Scheme check in checker/egramswaraj_stages.py: stage photos uploaded out of building order, and plinth or roof photos uploaded after the completion photo. Needs checker/extra/egramswaraj_stages.py (one import line) to be loaded; until then the checker reports it as left out.
